parts.name: foam-cap-top
parts.model_overhangs_review: The exact +Z/floor-down top-cup slice contains no support bodies or interface islands. Its 14.6 mm walls, attachment/conduit columns and four G Ganen mount columns rise from the bedded floor; the cup mouth and insert bores face upward, and the screw/conduit bores pass vertically through the floor. There is no enclosed supported cavity to clean. Keep the flat lid-bearing rim/column tops, full floor and bores as exported. Native path bounds stay within the plate; zero support is a slice measurement, not a claim about physical warping, insert fit or strength.

native_log_diagnostics_review: The only three messages name inherited profile commands: startup hotend-type detection T1001 and end-code control/unload T65535/T65279. They are recorded parser diagnostics for those authored machine-code blocks; the native slice returned0, has no plate warning and retains the verified intended filament/nozzle mapping. No separate geometry diagnostic is emitted.
review_scope: This exact fresh top-cap archive only, with all raw zero-support readings and null build-up fields preserved. Physical fit and cleanup remain unmeasured.
